column3: Sat behind the front group early - third at halfway - urged into fourth spot over 2f out - eased out and clipped another runner inside the final furlong and a half - finished strongly to get up right at the finish
Settled just behind the pace - 3rd at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out - bumped inside the final 200 yards - stayed on to snatch 2nd near the line

Sent to front early - lost command before 1f - settled second by halfway - urged on with 2f left - regained command with a furlong to run - flattened out and lost it again near the finish to end up third
Sat just behind the pace early - hit front after 1f - asked for effort over 2f out then overtaken inside final furlong - weakened late to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - moved up to sixth by halfway - driven on the rail approaching the last two furlongs and up to fifth with a furlong left - flattened out to finish one paced in fifth
Sat behind the pace - 7th at the halfway point - urged forward with two furlongs left - driven approaching the final furlong - stayed on to take 6th late
Held up at back - moved into midfield with two furlongs left - pushed along and stayed on inside final furlong to take 7th near the line
Sat close to pace early - 5th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left but found little - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 8th
Sat close to front group early - still 8th at halfway - eased into drive over 2f out and stayed on same gear to the line
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - asked for more soon after and unable to find any - faded to finish tenth
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - unable to close from a furlong out - well held at the finish
Held up towards back of pack - unable to challenge from over 2f out - well held at finish
Held up at the back - made no impression - well held in 13th
Slow into stride - held up towards back of the field - made no impression - finished well beaten in 14th
Held up at the back from the off - made no impression on the leaders - finished well beaten in 15th
Held up at the back - no impression on the front markers - well held at the finish
Slow into stride - held towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f left but unable to make headway
Sat close to the pace - 9th at halfway - driven early in the straight and gave way inside the final furlong
Settled midfield early - urged forward turning into the straight - lost touch with the pace and dropped away 2f out - finished well beaten in 19th
Led almost throughout - challenged hard inside final two furlongs - driven out and stayed on determinedly to prevail

Tracked the pace-setter early - still in second at halfway - closed up to share command approaching the last two furlongs - pressed for effort and lost the advantage inside the final furlong then held for second at the line
Sat close to the front group early - 6th at halfway - driven into 4th inside the final 2f - found more to move up into 3rd near the finish - stayed on for third beaten a half-length
Settled just behind the pace - 7th at halfway - moved into 5th approaching 2f out - pushed along and stayed on late to grab 4th near the line
Sat behind the pace - asked for effort on the rail with 2f left and found little in 4th approaching the final furlong - dropped a spot near the line to finish 5th beaten 3 lengths
Sat just behind the front pack - up to 4th at halfway - driven into 3rd approaching the final 2f - lost momentum inside the final furlong and faded to finish 6th
Sat close behind the front group early - third at the midpoint - asked for effort with 2f left but found little in 7th approaching the final furlong - stayed on same gait to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - urged into effort in the home straight - pressed forward wide over 2f out - into eighth close home and stayed on to finish 4.5 lengths off
Held up at the back - urged forward approaching 2f out - unable to close from inside the final furlong - finished well held in 9th
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort turning into the straight - unable to threaten from over 3f out - finished well held in 10th
Held up towards the back - driven approaching straight - unable to threaten leaders from 2f out - eventually well held
Held up towards the back - looked unfurnished with 2f left - unable to find extra when asked - well held in 12th
Settled midfield - asked for effort inside final 3f - found little more and dropped away - finished well beaten in 13th
Slow to break - held up towards the back - made no impression through the race - well held at the finish
Held up in last place - made no impression - well held throughout
Settled in the pack early - urged into 6th spot with over two furlongs left - hit the front approaching the final furlong and stayed on strongly to win
Settled midfield early - moved into 5th approaching 2f out then pushed into 2nd inside final furlong - held on without further improvement to finish second
Settled in the pack - urged forward approaching 2f out - improved to 6th inside final furlong - found extra to take 3rd near the line
Up with the front group - 6th at halfway - niggled over 2f out - tight for room over 1f out - moved to 3rd inside 150 yards but had nothing more to give and dropped to 4th near the line
Settled in the pack early - back in 9th at halfway - urged forward approaching final two furlongs - stayed on well to finish 5th
Sat close to the pace early - 5th at halfway - driven approaching straight and dropped back 2f out - rallied inside final furlong to finish 6th
Sat behind the front group early - up to 2nd by halfway - driven to share the advantage 2f out then lost it approaching the final furlong - had nothing more left and dropped away close home
Held up towards the back - urged into the straight - under pressure 2f out - stayed on late to finish 8th beaten 4.5 lengths

Up with the front group and pulling hard early - moved to the front after 1f - pressed and then challenged over 2f out - surrendered the advantage over 1f out - faded inside the final furlong to finish 9th
Held up at the back - no impression made through the race - well held at the finish
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout - finished 11th
Went straight to front - overtaken before 1f - sat 3rd by halfway - urged with 2f to run and found nothing over 1f out - dropped away close home
Sat handy behind the front group - 4th at halfway - urged into the straight - flattened out under pressure inside the final 2f to finish well held
Held up at the back - made no impression - finished well beaten in 14th
Held up towards back of pack - 8th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out then found nothing and dropped away
Held up at the back - up to 4th by halfway - improved into 3rd approaching 2f out - pushed into 2nd with a furlong left - challenging from 200 yards and got up near the line
Sat behind the front-runner early - still second at halfway - driven up to share command over 2f out - edged in front inside the final furlong - held on gamely but caught right on the line
Set the early gallop out front - driven and headed approaching 2f out then eased back into third with a furlong left - held no more in reserve and stayed on at one speed to finish third
Held up towards the back - driven into contention over 2f out to move up into 4th - stayed on at the same rate through the closing stages
Sat behind the front group early - 3rd at halfway - asked for effort in the straight and 4th over 2f out - faded late to finish 5th
Went straight to front early - roused into effort with over 2f remaining - driven out and stayed on strongly from the final furlong to score
Tracked the front-runner - 2nd at halfway - under pressure from over 2f out - one-paced inside the final furlong to finish second
Settled just behind the front group early - 4th at halfway - moved into 3rd 2f out - pushed along and edged forward inside final furlong - got up to score right on the line

Settled just behind the front pair - third at halfway - urged forward into second past the 2f mark - edged in front approaching the final furlong then driven on under pressure from 200 yards out - unable to find more and caught in the final strides
Held up at the back of the pack early - closed on the front group approaching the final furlong then pushed along and stayed on - grabbed 3rd late
Sat just behind the front group early - urged forward in 9th with 2f left - asked for effort inside final furlong and up to 3rd near the line - couldn't find more and slipped back to finish 4th
Settled midpack early - moved into 7th with 2f left then up to 4th inside the final furlong - flattened out late to finish 5th
Sat close to the front group early - 6th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left but couldn't find more - stayed on at same speed to finish 6th beaten 2.25 lengths
Held a midfield spot early - urged forward with two furlongs left and stayed on gamely late - dropped to 7th near the line
Held a central position - asked for effort with over 2f left and stayed on inside the final furlong - dropped to 8th near the line
Held up towards back of pack - driven on with 2f left and again 1f out - found modest late progress close home finishing 9th
Went straight to front - urged forward with 2f left before giving up the advantage inside the final furlong - had nothing more and dropped away 150 yards from home
Handy behind front group - 5th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out with little response - dropped away inside final furlong
Held a midfield position early - urged on approaching 2f out and again with a furlong left - found nothing more and dropped away inside the final furlong and a half
Tracked the pace early - up to 2nd at halfway - dropped to 4th and driven approaching 2f out - flattened out into 6th after being denied room 200 yards out and allowed to finish in own time
Sat close to the front group early - 7th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but found little - dropped away inside the final furlong
Held up towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - found nothing more and gave way in the final stages
Held up towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - stayed under pressure and edged closer in the closing stages - finished 16th
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout
Held in the pack early - urged forward with 2f left - lost touch and dropped away inside final furlong - finished 18th
Held up at the back from the start - no impression made on the leading group - well held at the finish
Struggled to hold pace from the off - stayed off the pace throughout - no real impression made - trailed home well beaten in 20th
Held around midfield early - driven for effort with over 2f left - couldn't find more and dropped away - finished well beaten in 21st
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - improved on the inner with 3f to run - hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on under pressure to prevail by a whisker
Settled in fourth early - moved left and made progress inside the final two furlongs - closed on the leader entering the last furlong and kept battling on the rails - edged out by a whisker
Sat close behind pace-setter - still in with hope inside final two furlongs - held in third with no further gain near the line
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort with 2f left then lost command inside the last furlong - kept plugging in the closing stages to finish fourth
Tracked the pace - moved across left approaching 4f out then unbalanced and slipped back over 2f out - rallied in the closing stages to finish 5th
Drifted left at the off - settled towards the back before making progress on the outer approaching the 4f marker - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Sat behind front group - fourth at halfway - improved into third with 2f left - shaken up to hit front approaching final furlong and stayed on strongly to win
Settled midfield early - moved into 5th with 2f left then 3rd inside final furlong - edged into 2nd close home - stayed on same gear to finish second
Held up towards the back - still 6th at halfway - driven for effort with 2f left - stayed on well late to snatch 3rd near the line
Went straight to front - urged forward approaching 2f out then slipped to 4th with a furlong left - stayed on same gait to finish 4th
Up with the front group - nudged forward to move into 2nd over 2f out - dropped back to 5th in the final 100 yards having found little
Tracked the pace early - disputed second at halfway - dropped to fourth under pressure with two furlongs left - weakened late to finish sixth
Held up early towards the back - made no impression through the race - finished well held in 7th
Sat close to pace early - 5th at halfway then squeezed for room approaching 2f out - lost touch and dropped away inside final furlong
Tracked front pack early - moved into second with plenty in hand approaching 3f out - hit the front 2f out and opened up a lead from the furlong marker - strolled home unchallenged
Settled towards the back - boxed in approaching 2f out - moved left and made progress inside the final 2f - up into second late but no match for the winner
Tracked the pace - driven from 4f out and found extra 2f out - edged out of second inside the final furlong finishing third
Settled towards the back early - moved left and made progress out wide before 2f out - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth beaten well
Settled in the pack early - nudged into contention approaching 3f out - dropped away with over a furlong left - eventually beaten well - finished 5th
Slow to break - settled at back of field - held there approaching 2f out - responded in closing stages to finish sixth
Slow to begin - settled towards back - pushed along wide 3f out before fading inside final furlong
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to close - well held at the finish
Settled in touch early - hit the front 3f out but overtaken 2f out - dropped away from over a furlong out to finish well beaten
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost front spot 3f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished tenth

Settled just behind pace early - fighting for control under restraint - made ground into contention 2f out - hit the front approaching the final furlong and challenged inside it - stayed on strongly to score
Settled in the pack early - moved through on the outer approaching final two furlongs to press the leader - narrowly denied at the line
Sluggish start - held up towards rear - finished strongly out wide to snatch third in the final strides
Settled midfield - angled left approaching final furlong - stayed on inside but couldn't reach the leading two - edged out of third near the line finishing fourth
Settled towards the back of the pack - boxed in with two furlongs to run - found room and moved across left approaching the final furlong - stayed on late but never a threat to the front
Settled around midfield - made progress into contention with 2f left - flattened out inside the closing 75 yards - finished 6th beaten 3½ lengths
Hesitant start - held towards the back - improved position inside the last two furlongs then kept on in the closing stages to finish seventh
Settled just off the pace early - boxed in with two furlongs left before angling right approaching the final furlong - unable to close on the front group finishing 8th beaten 4.25 lengths
Sluggish to break - held up towards the back for the remainder - never involved in the finish - beaten 4.75 lengths in 9th
Travelled just off the pace on the outer - pushed along with 3f left - drifted right approaching the final 2f and found space tight - lost touch inside the last to finish 10th
Settled at the back - pulled hard early - pushed along 2f out and always well out of contention
Sat close to the front group early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - lost ground inside the last furlong to finish 12th
Sent clear from the break - disputed pace before hitting the front once more approaching 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left - dropped away close home to finish 13th
Went straight to front early - lost command approaching 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 14th
Set the pace early - pushed along and edged in front close home before that - kept going strongly to the finish
Handy in the pack early - drifted right to nose ahead approaching final furlong - overtaken close home and stayed on to be second
Settled in behind pace - angled right approaching final furlong - stayed on late to finish third beaten under two lengths
Raced wide behind the front group - urged forward with over 3f left - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish 4th

Fractionally sluggish into stride - settled towards the back of the pack - improved position before angling left with 2f remaining - squeezed for space and shifted left again inside the final furlong - couldn't find enough gears to reach the leading group
Settled midpack and wide - pulling hard early - made ground under a furlong out then lost momentum close home
Settled towards the back early - lost touch approaching 3f out - finished off late without threatening
Tracked front group hugging the rail - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - eventually finished eighth
Sluggish start - settled near the back - lost touch over 3f out and never threatened - finished well held in 9th
Sluggish start - held up at the back - ran into trouble over 5f out and quickly eased down
Set the pace from the off - opened up a advantage passing the furlong marker - stayed on strongly to score with ease
Settled towards back early - made ground wide 2f out - kept on inside final furlong to take second - unable to close on winner
Settled in the pack early - improved into contention from 3f out - closed on the leader with a furlong left but couldn't get closer - edged out of second near the line to finish third
Tracked the front group - urged forward with over 2f left - lost ground close home - finished fourth
Dwelt at start - held up towards back - urged into effort with 4f left - moved left approaching final furlong - stayed on well to close but held for 5th
Shared front spot early then eased back to sit handy - driven approaching 3f out - unable to make ground final furlong
Handy on the rail early - dropped away inside final furlong - eventually finished 7th
Settled off the pace early - made progress inside the final 3f - eased over to the left approaching 2f out - unable to threaten leaders and faded out of contention finishing 8th
Pulling hard early - settled in the pack - pushed along over 2f out and soon faded
Sluggish start - eager to go forward early - moved up to challenge leader 6f out - dropped away over 2f out and faded to finish tenth

Hesitant start and settled at rear - urged forward with 5f left - moved left approaching 3f out - gained ground wide with a furlong left - hit front inside final furlong - drew clear for a comfortable win
Handy in the pack early - hit the front over a furlong out before being overtaken inside the final furlong - unable to fight back and beaten 2.5 lengths
Tracked the pace - lost ground under 2f out - rallied late to grab third
Held up towards the back - moved left and made progress into contention over 2f out before drifting right approaching the final furlong - unable to threaten and gave up fourth near the finish
Held up at the back - shortened the gap late inside the final furlong - finished 5th
Sat close to the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left and drifted off a true line - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack early - asked for effort with over two furlongs left - squeezed for space inside the final furlong and unable to threaten - finished well held in 7th
Settled around midfield - driven for progress inside final furlong but bumped there - lost place quickly after and finished well beaten
Went straight to front - pressed for effort and lost command inside final furlong - dropped away quickly after - finished 9th
Slightly hampered leaving the stalls - held up at the back throughout - never involved - well held at the finish
Sluggish start - stayed at the back throughout - well held in 11th
Settled handy on the outer - pressed leaders inside final two furlongs then went ahead entering last - kept finding through to the line
Went clear early - pushed along and closed down inside final two furlongs then overtaken - edged out late for second
Held up towards the back - driven approaching 2f out and lost ground inside final furlong - improved into third close home
Handy early - driven approaching 2f out then dropped away inside final furlong - eased out of third late to finish fourth
Held up at the back and asked for effort early - drifted off a straight line and dropped away 2f out - well beaten in 5th
Squeezed for space early - travelling wide with the pack and needing driving while inexperienced 2f out - moved through to hit the front a furlong out - finished strongly to win
Settled towards the back early - squeezed for space approaching 2f out then found extra pace to close on leader inside final furlong - unable to find more and finished second
Tracked the pace early - pushed along and drifted right approaching the final 2f then wandered left inside the last furlong losing second place - unable to threaten again finishing third

Drifted right from the stalls - went clear in front - drifted right again and pressed under the whip inside the final two furlongs before being overtaken - lost place approaching the last furlong to finish fourth
